about: Verdicts on every rule code in rule-sheet.md (data commit a592331). verdict: holds | partly | does not hold. Section 4 pattern rules keep their codes A1-A11; section 13 approval items are written 13.A1-13.A4 because the sheet uses A1-A4 twice. Rules without a code are listed under a short key (sec<N>-...). Scripts named here are in check/scripts/ unless marked 'sheet:'. F-numbers point to findings.md.

verdicts.evidence: classes.rarity (hover, drone uncommon), naval source_only, 20 lockables in CS $defs/lockable, spice 1-5 and seed minLength 1 in CS; equal odds and spice default 2 correctly marked NEW.
rarity.json description: 'a class or part you choose yourself is always used'; classes.json description says the same.
CS description: reproduction key = generator.version + data_version + seed + spice + inputs + locked values.

Sheet: one stream per step. P2.3 and CS: one stream per field ('seed + field name'). Steps 2 (tier, flavour), 13 (primary, secondary, conditional) and 14 (abilities, modes) each hold separately lockable parts. F13.

Matches P2.3's order with new places marked. But the signature's seat is chosen at step 4 before the crew model at step 12 (A5 needs a commander to own an ability), and the secondary weapon (step 13) uses key budget before extras (step 14) without saying so. F21.
Same as validate.mjs combinationProblems (classes, min_tier, allowed, excluded, read for each term on the profile).
validate.mjs checkTerm: requires groups matched against the whole card.
pattern.schema implies: 'Parts the generator sets before rolling the rest.'
Method marked NEW. Its clash with the passengers rule is under sec7-passengers.

Marked NEW with question SP, but SP speaks only of 'your inputs'; with G14 a rolled role also forces above-gate parts at spice 1 (sheet: feasibility.mjs lists 156 combinations needing them), against T6 and P2.3 'Spice 1 offers only common parts'. Also clashes with 13.A3's min_spice check. F3, F11.
faction-flavours avoided_until_spice 3; extension to implied parts marked NEW.
P2.3: 'A card that breaks a rule is rerolled.' 200 marked NEW. (A lock can change which attempt is accepted; see F13.)
proposal 2.2 plan change of 12 November: 'each card records the data version it was rolled on'.

No rarity field on roles, sizes, speed-bands, armour-classes, damage-types, weapon-delivery, range-bands, target-types, weapon-traits, sight-bands, nature, availability, resources, cooldown-bands, team-play-hooks (vocab-dump.txt).
fields.md mobility.handling: 'Use the mobility type's default unless the Handling tie-break gives a reason'.
Default range is real (default_range). No rule for an implied or required range two or more bands from the default. F26.

Defaults, high-air list and the anti-air exemption match weapon-families description and validate.mjs exempt(). Unstated: aim-models carry rarities (limited-arc, auto-target, radial uncommon) yet mounts are rolled by 'default three times as likely'. F26.

List correctly marked NEW with question RF; anti-infantry matches fields.md roles.secondary; infiltration patterns match (rf-rarity.mjs: capture-structure, cloak, disguise, hijack-vehicle, infest-vehicle). Spice side effect: see G14.

Roles are rolled among those the class and tier 'can hold', not those that fit at the card's spice. All engineer, logistics and infiltrator fit patterns are uncommon or rare (rf-rarity.mjs), so a rolled role brings above-gate parts to spice-1 cards; T6 forbids that. F3.
Fields exist as listed (points and brings absent from all terms). Misses 'themes' and 'label', which are not read either (low).
rarity.json weights common [10,10,8,6,5], uncommon [0,4,5,6,6], rare [0,0,0,3,5]; min_spice 1, 2, 4.
'spice 3 differs from spice 2 only in odds (and avoided parts)': 130 variants have min_spice 3 (counts.mjs), and S6 opens them at spice 3. The tesla example (30, 30, 10, 0) holds. F14.
favoured_weight 3 on soviet, allied, empire.
faction-flavours and rarity descriptions: one step more common, never where a class rarity applies; no field (R holds it).
rarity description and pattern.schema class_rarity: 'used instead of rarity'.
avoided_until_spice 3; balance-flags off-flavour severity warn.
pattern.schema flavour_lean: 'Flavours that roll it more often.' No number; treatment marked NEW with question FL.
variants[].min_spice exists; equal odds marked NEW.
Filters match validate.mjs card checks (slot, classes, min_tier, requires, excludes, implies); role weight marked NEW.
validate.mjs reads vo.X || G.X for kinds, min_tier, classes, requires, excludes, implies (an empty override list replaces).
kinds per variant, ultimate min_tier t3 (ability-kinds). The cooldown gap it creates with A4 is under A4.

Key kinds need a cooldown (validate.mjs), passive/triggered none (CS). But toggle and deploy get only spam and short, so a stun-class toggle/deploy (burrow/erupt) has no allowed band under HC3: never offered, uncounted (hc-cooldown.mjs). F9.
2A, seat-roles, balance-flags idle-seat; fields.md armament[].seat (2A: the driver fires the main weapon, other mounts go to the gunner). Placement marked NEW. Fallback clash: sec7-who-does-what.
CS abilities maxItems 3; brief 'tiers cap the number of abilities'; targets marked NEW.
All 16 generator fields named and placed; conflicts_with read both ways as in validate.mjs.
Only two implied pattern links exist: carry-passengers/tunnel-carrier -> burrow, heal-from-debuff/own-fire -> leave-hazard-zone.

Rule is NEW, but its cited sources say the opposite: CS modes 'A second form from a transform or deploy pattern' (via example 'deploy-siege-mode'); fields.md modes[] 'deploy, siege and transform modes'. Not a question; schema wording change not in section 13. validate.mjs reads no card mode at all (card-tests2.mjs test Z). F7.
passenger-sets-weapon base and leech-weapon-on-kill imply weapon:adaptive; leech requires another family; CS conditional maxItems 4.
2,346 pairs = 69x68/2; 2 candidates reproduced (sheet: duplicates.mjs); stack-to-overload already lists freeze-and-shatter as variant-of.
slot 54/10/5, rarity 19/44/6, min_tier 44/23/2, signature 36-62 and 8-31 reproduce (my-counts.mjs, my-sigcount.mjs). 'hard-control rules then keep 4 variants out': 5 with burrow/erupt.
tiers.json max_keys 2/3/4, max_passive 1, max_keys_per_seat 3.

Matches validate.mjs. But tiers.json description: 'A signature fired with primary fire counts as primary fire only when it is the unit's primary weapon' (then it is not a key), and 1B puts the infester's pounce on LMB; K-a counts every key kind. A second count conflict, not raised. F6.
Decision 1B and tiers.json description list the same six universal keys.
max_keys_per_seat 3; seat-roles driver 'Moves the unit'.

mobility-traits description says key traits 'need their matching mechanic pattern', but deploy-anchor (pattern deploy-siege-mode) is implied by four variants of other patterns (extra-problems.mjs). Read literally, those cards also need a deploy-siege-mode ability. F5.
52, 46 and 14 of 15 reproduce, but 'counted once, only one variant costs 2 keys' uses keys.mjs's broader rule (any implied key trait), not 13.A2's wording, which leaves 5 variants at 2 keys. F5.
1B layout. 'Shift NEW': CS controls input example already lists Shift (low).
validate.mjs: balance.keys must equal the counted keys.

Definition from balance-flags ('a stun, freeze or attach effect') and 5B/5C is right; 11 escape indices spot-checked hold. Missing: weapon families cryo ('freezes the target solid'), emp ('can't move, can't fire, or both'), psionic, magnetic; abilities become-invulnerable/lock-and-pulse and retaliate-on-hit/reflect-window (stun attackers). F2.

Right for the stun trait, but its own reason (a weapon has no cooldown) applies to cryo and emp weapons, which the word lists say freeze or stop the target and which are common at spice 1 for allied and empire. F2.
5B 'Stuns only from T2'; weapon-traits stun min_tier t2.
5B medium or longer cooldown. (Interaction with A4: see A4.)

5B requires a stated escape, but 'word for word' fails the plan's example card: its as_target paraphrases infest-vehicle as_target[1] (proposed-checks-on-example.mjs). The attach delivery's escape has no sentence anywhere. F1.
No card field for duration; honestly marked not checked.
infest-vehicle min_tier t1; 5B's tier limit names stuns, and its text treats latches as shaken off by hold F. A silent choice, though (F20).
55 variants (44/11) and the 7 problem lines reproduce; 'never offered: 2' misses burrow/erupt (A4 + HC3).
crew-models: squad infantry/drone rare; driver-gunner-commander min_tier t2.
solo-fallback rarities common/uncommon/rare/rare match 2A's 'B and C only as rare' and 'auto-gunner uncommon'.
2A default holds, but seat-swap ('no weapon works from the driver seat') and needs-crew ('can't ... fire the main gun') contradict 'the buyer fires the primary'; both can be rolled. F17.

fields.md Paired entries ties passenger seats to the two patterns, but disguise/disguised-carrier implies passengers:>=1 (excludes only huge), and rope-drop, storm-a-garrison, squad-in-vehicle, wreck-fort, anchor-by-choice, booby-trapped-shell, raise-again require passengers; no cap for tiny or small. F16.
CS body.count '1 unless the crew model is squad (then 2-5)'; odds NEW.
nature classes organic infantry/walker/aircraft (walker, aircraft rare); remote excludes organic and crewed-machine.
unique min_tier t2 holds; rarities NEW with question AV, but at spice 5 the weights make about 31% of T2+ cards unique and 69% capped, which AV does not show. F19.

3C default matches validate.mjs header text, but bail-out is excluded only for infantry, so drones (made uncrewed) can bail out, about 1 in 4 drone cards under the stated weights; respawn ('Nothing is left') + wreck is allowed by the groups. F15.
sight-bands short/medium/long; weights NEW.
CS max 2. All sensor traits are uncommon, so at spice 1 the 0/1/2 count asks for traits that cannot be given; what happens is not said. F21.
mobility target_type: rotor and jetpack low-air, jet and airship high-air.
CS needs only the signature category; the role condition (support, transport, infiltrator, engineer, logistics) is new but not marked NEW. Not checked by validate.mjs (test W).
2A extra seats add a second gun; chance marked NEW.
resources description: 'A card has at most one.'
CS maxima: traits 2, armour models 1-2, weapon traits 3; weights NEW.
validate.mjs: multi-seat crew needs a solo fallback.
Cites the on-death descriptions, but its groups allow respawn + wreck, which respawn's description ('Nothing is left') rules out. F15.
balance-flags idle-seat: 'An operating seat owns no weapon or ability.' Not checked today (card-tests.mjs test S); 13.A3 proposes it.

Pattern counts hold (1 and 1 per base block; 77 and 115 overrides), but 'parts add none' contradicts the plan's example card (strength speed:fast, weakness armour-class:light come from parts) and the vocabulary schema's brings ('filled in with the generator, Phase 2'). F1, F12.

258/70/9/5 reproduce as written, but per effective variant block 21 links are not guaranteed (my-sw.mjs), including repair-allies/heal-aura, which empties implies but keeps weapon:repair-tool as strength and weakness. F10.
Pairing exists (B3, CS, validate.mjs index check), but the same-ability rule fails the example card's second pair (speed:fast with armour-class:light). F1.
fields.md Matchups (7): 'about two to five ... a guide, not a cap'; cap marked NEW.

validate.mjs matches(): role primary or secondary, weapons incl. conditional (test N), category main only (test F), target from mobility with tiny/small ground as infantry (tests L, M), immune never (test P).
P2.3 'some valid card can actually satisfy'; balance-flags no-counter names countered by.
52 distinct, 3 unsatisfiable, no block left empty (sheet: counters.mjs re-run; my cb-odd.mjs: the rare kinds are satisfiable).
damage-types description: strong_vs and immune 'drive the generator's counter hints'; method marked NEW.
275 links in 18 kinds and 125 in 17 kinds reproduce (link-kinds.mjs).

my-points.mjs: all 69 patterns parsed from the table, 0 differences; stored values 4/4 cost, 3/4 power (lay-smoke), 4/4 complexity. Note: power is 2 or 3 for 68 of 69 patterns (no balance risk is 'low'), so it barely separates them.
Middle terms are the ranked lists' medium terms; numbers NEW.
Rime Burr power 4 reproduced (2 + speed 1 + secondary 1).
Rime Burr complexity 4 reproduced (card says 3; the sheet says so).
Rime Burr cost 4 = low reproduced. Every band is reachable in every tier (sums T1 1-13, T2 1-16, T3 2-20), so the expected bands can be met; how often the warning fires is not tested (low).
Severities match balance-flags; name-collision widened to the signature name (stated).

'Every line taken from a pattern is our own paraphrased text' is true, but 106 of 1,657 template-fed fields name a real game, franchise, faction, unit or a wiki (text-leaks2.mjs), e.g. band-together counterplay/0, block-abilities counterplay/0, launch-drones variant timed-wave summary. F4.
Counts reproduce (122 words, 1,372 working and 3,640 signature names). Own-knowledge collisions: Halcyon, Daybreak, Sledge, Anvil, Badger and others; '88' and the C4/K9 codes. F22.

0 collisions holds for the script's sets only. By its own definition ('every game title in the data') Rain collides with Risk of Rain 2 (reinforce-squad.json); Chisel is the weapon name of Iron Harvest's M-22 Stark (units file); Crane is in the source term 'repair crane'. F22.
Brief and P2.3: seeds reproduce exactly.
Sound for one stream per field; with one stream per step it can fail for two lockable parts in one step. F13.

Checked by validate.mjs plus 13.A3 only; tests show the validator also misses HC1, unarmed rule, solo fallback, body count, modes, passengers, seats, adaptive, avoided parts, role fit (card-tests2.mjs), none added by 13.A3. F8.
7 x 4 x 4 x 17 x 5 = 9,520; unavailable list reproduces (sheet: unavailable.mjs).
Follows from N3.
'the roll records why': the card schema has no field for it (additionalProperties false everywhere); and G14 + G5 make it fail for rolled roles. F3, F11.
Fine; 'From: A1 below' means 13.A1 (code collision, low).
names.mjs re-run passes; limits as T-a.

True that no word-list file changes, but only because per-term data the approved schema places in word lists (terms[].points 'Proposed with the generator (Phase 2)', brings 'filled in with the generator, Phase 2') or that would be term fields (availability rarities, sight weights, favoured step) goes into rules.json. F12.
Wording describes the new schema and files. Escape lines are stored as list indexes into pattern texts, which a later text edit can silently break (low).

Wording covers only 'the pattern it stands for'; deploy-anchor stands for deploy-siege-mode, so the 4 variants of other patterns that imply it still count 2 keys. The question K1 promises 'only one variant costs 2 keys'. F5.

As worded, M3 and HC4 reject the plan's example card (CI would fail); the min_spice check conflicts with G5; HC1, modes, unarmed, solo fallback, body count, passengers, seats, adaptive, avoided parts and role fit are left out. F1, F8, F11.
CS generator.data_version text and fields.md say 'vocabularies and patterns' only; the new wording is exact for G8.

Sample of 23 entries over all 12 kinds: every one holds at its file and path (check-data-problems.mjs). Kinds missed: inherited strength links with emptied implies (heal-aura), hard control outside the list, stun-class variant with no usable cooldown (erupt), passengers needed without a passenger pattern, key trait implied by another pattern vs K-d, pattern text naming real games, comparators in strengths and weaknesses (36). F10, F23.
Real choice, fair options; but the promised effect needs wider wording than 13.A2, and the second count conflict (LMB signature) is not asked. F5, F6.
Real choice; the options never mention weapons (cryo, emp freeze or stop) or latches at T1. F2, F20.
Real choice; understated: it also covers rolled roles and requirements, and needs a record the card schema lacks. F3, F11.
Real choice; infest-vehicle is uncommon with flavour_lean soviet, so the example in the question is right.
Real choice; omits that with SP A it brings uncommon patterns to spice-1 cards whose role was rolled. F3.
Omits that the example card already has part-based strengths and weaknesses and that the approved schema plans brings for Phase 2. F12.
Omits the schema's own place for points (generator.points, terms[].points) and that the formula gives power 2 or 3 to 68 of 69 patterns. F12.
Omits the high-spice effect: at spice 5, about 31% unique and 69% capped. F19.
